tickets.title: Responsive Navbar
tickets.description: Builds a dark-themed responsive navbar with a hamburger menu for mobile screens and a dropdown menu item.
tasks: Builds a dark-themed responsive navbar with a hamburger menu for mobile screens and a dropdown menu item.
learning_objectives: Build components without relying on custom CSS.
tickets.evaluation: `check_class_used("navbar-expand-lg")` `check_attribute_used("data-bs-toggle", "collapse")` `check_class_used("dropdown-menu")` **[A] Visual (40 pts)**: 40 pts if mobile menu collapses correctly. **[B] Logic (40 pts)**: 40 pts for correct `data-bs-*` attributes linking toggler to collapse div. **[C] Quality (10 pts)**: 10 pts for aria roles on dropdowns.
common_mistakes: Forgetting the data-bs-toggle attributes for the hamburger menu.
hints: Check the Bootstrap documentation for navbar-expand classes to handle mobile collapsing.

tickets.title: Profile Cards
tickets.description: Uses the `card` component to build a user profile display with a header image, body text, and a footer with a primary button.
tasks: Uses the `card` component to build a user profile display with a header image, body text, and a footer with a primary button.
learning_objectives: Build components without relying on custom CSS.
tickets.evaluation: `check_class_used("card-body")` `check_class_used("btn-primary")` `check_class_used("w-100")` **[A] Visual (40 pts)**: 40 pts for exact border radius and padding matching. **[B] Logic (40 pts)**: 40 pts for `card-img-top`, `card-body`, and `card-footer` usage. **[C] Quality (10 pts)**: 10 pts for `alt` tags on images.
common_mistakes: Writing custom CSS for things Bootstrap utilities can already do (e.g. margin, padding).
hints: Make sure you are using exact Bootstrap utility classes instead of inline styles.
Use browser developer tools to inspect elements.
